task: Predict progesterone receptor status in breast carcinoma. Classes: PR negative vs. PR positive. On H&E, PR-positive tumors more often show luminal differentiation with lower grade and better tubule formation, whereas PR-negative tumors more often show higher grade, solid growth, pleomorphism, and increased mitotic activity.

classes.0: PR-negative breast carcinoma with less luminal differentiation, higher nuclear grade, and more proliferative solid growth.
classes.1: PR-positive breast carcinoma with more luminal-type morphology, better gland formation, and generally lower grade features.
